# Sri Konark Plywood & Hardware

> Premium plywood, laminates, hardware fittings, and adhesives in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh.

## About

Sri Konark Plywood & Hardware is a building materials retailer established in 2015 in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, India. We serve homeowners, builders, carpenters, and interior designers with a wide range of plywood, laminates, hardware fittings, adhesives, and modular kitchen solutions.

## Location

13/3/379/21, Sri K M Saifullah Over Brg, Srinivas Nagar, Anantapur, AP 515001, India
Phone: +91 96525 15211

## Hours

Monday–Saturday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Sunday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM

## Products

- Plywood: Marine, BWP, BWR, MR Grade, Gurjan, Hardwood, Commercial, Fire Retardant, Waterproof
- Boards: Block Board, Particle Board, MFC Board
- Doors & Frames: Flush Doors, WPC Door Frames
- Laminates: Decorative, HPL, Sunmica, Acrylic, Greenlam
- Veneers & Edge Banding: Veneer Sheets, PVC Edge Bands, Edge Banding Tape
- Hardware: Hettich, Ebco, Hafele — Soft-Close Hinges, Drawer Channels, Kitchen Baskets, Cabinet Handles, Wardrobe Fittings, Telescopic Channels
- Adhesives: Fevicol, Jivanjor (PVC Xtra, Lamino), Araldite Epoxy, Silicone Sealants, Wood Glue
- Modular Kitchen: Complete fittings and accessories
